ns2:section.sectionText: If you are a degree-seeking student taking a mix of campus-based and online delivered courses during the summer term, you should register for the course section(s) noted as ?CB?. Students enrolling in these sections will be charged the campus range tuition. This is a fully online course with no face to face meetings.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
